description_en: Configures Layer 4 forwarding rule attributes, including session persistence and DDoS mitigation policies
description_zh: 包括会话保持和DDoS防护策略
kebab_example: aliyun ddoscoo config-layer4-rule-attribute --instance-id ddoscoo-cn-XXXXX --forward-protocol TCP --frontend-port 233 --config Slimit_:_CpsEnable_:1,_MaxconnEnable_:1,_Cps_:1,_Maxconn_:1_,_Sla_:_CpsEnable_:1,_MaxconnEnable_:1,_Cps_:100,_Maxconn_:1000_,_PayloadLen_:_Min_:0,_Max_:6000 --api-version 2017-12-28 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ConfigLayer4RuleAttribute

parameters.help_en: The forwarding protocol. Valid values: TCP, UDP
parameters.name: forward_protocol

parameters.help_en:
The configuration information. Pass a JSON string of the TcpConfig or UdpConfig object.

The TcpConfig structure is described as follows:

PersistenceTimeout, Integer type, required. The timeout period of session persistence, in seconds. Default value: 0, which indicates shutdown.
Synproxy, String type, required. The False Source setting of the DDoS mitigation policy. Valid values: off, on.
NodataConn, String type, required. The Empty Connection setting of the DDoS mitigation policy. Valid values: off, on.
Sla, Struct type, required. The destination rate limiting configuration. For more information about the structure, see Sla.
Slimit, Struct type, required. The source rate limiting configuration. For more information about the structure, see Slimit.
PayloadLen, Struct type, required. The packet filtering configuration. For more information about the structure, see PayloadLen.

The UdpConfig structure is described as follows:

PersistenceTimeout, Integer type, required. The timeout period of session persistence, in seconds. Default value: 0, which indicates shutdown.
Synproxy, String type, required. The False Source setting of the DDoS mitigation policy. Valid values: off, on.
NodataConn, String type, required. The Empty Connection setting of the DDoS mitigation policy. Valid values: off, on.
Sla, Struct type, required. The destination rate limiting configuration. For more information about the structure, see Sla.
Slimit, Struct type, required. The source rate limiting configuration. For more information about the structure, see Slimit.
PayloadLen, Struct type, required. The packet filtering configuration. For more information about the structure, see PayloadLen.

The Sla structure is described as follows:

Cps, Integer type, required. The maximum number of new connections to a destination IP address in the DDoS mitigation policy. Valid values: 100 to 100000.
Maxconn, Integer type, required. The maximum number of concurrent connections to a destination IP address in the DDoS mitigation policy. Valid values: 1000 to 1000000.
CpsEnable, Integer type, required. Specifies whether to enable Cps. Valid values: 0 (disable cps), 1 (default, enable cps).
MaxconnEnable, Integer type, required. Specifies whether to enable Maxconnection. Valid values: 0 (disable maxconn), 1 (default, enable maxconn).

The Slimit structure is described as follows:

Cps, Integer type, required. The maximum number of new connections from a source IP address in the DDoS mitigation policy. Valid values: 100 to 100000.
Maxconn, Integer type, required. The maximum number of concurrent connections from a source IP address in the DDoS mitigation policy. Valid values: 1000 to 1000000.
CpsEnable, Integer type, required. Specifies whether to enable Cps. Valid values: 0 (disable cps), 1 (default, enable cps).
MaxconnEnable, Integer type, required. Specifies whether to enable Maxconnection. Valid values: 0 (disable maxconn), 1 (default, enable maxconn).
CpsMode, Integer type, required. The source new connection rate limiting switch. Valid values: 1 (shutdown), 2 (automatic).

The PayloadLen structure is described as follows:

Min, Integer type, required. The minimum packet length for the Packet Length Limit setting of the DDoS mitigation policy. Valid values: 0 to 6000.
Max, Integer type, required. The maximum packet length for the Packet Length Limit setting of the DDoS mitigation policy. Valid values: 0 to 6000
parameters.help_zh:
配置信息，传入TcpConfig或UdpConfig对象JSON串。

TcpConfig的具体结构描述见如下：

PersistenceTimeout，Integer类型，必选，会话保持的超时时间，单位为秒。默认为0，表示关闭。
Synproxy，String类型，必选，DDoS防护策略的虚假源，取值：off、on。
NodataConn，String类型，必选，DDoS防护策略的空连接，取值：off、on。
Sla，Struct类型，必选，目的限制配置。具体结构描述见Sla。
Slimit，Struct类型，必选，源限制配置。具体结构描述见Slimit。
PayloadLen，Struct类型，必选，包过滤配置。具体结构描述见PayloadLen。

UdpConfig的具体结构描述如下：

PersistenceTimeout，Integer类型，必选，会话保持的超时时间，单位为秒。默认为0，表示关闭。
Synproxy，String类型，必选，DDoS防护策略的虚假源，取值：off、on。
NodataConn，String类型，必选，DDoS防护策略的空连接，取值：off、on。
Sla，Struct类型，必选，目的限制配置。具体结构描述见Sla。
Slimit，Struct类型，必选，源限制配置。具体结构描述见Slimit。
PayloadLen，Struct类型，必选，包过滤配置。具体结构描述见PayloadLen。

Sla的具体结构描述如下：

Cps，Integer类型，必选，DDoS防护策略/目的新建连接限速，取值范围：100~100,000。
Maxconn，Integer类型，必选，DDoS防护策略/目的并发连接限速，取值范围：1,000~1,000,000。
CpsEnable，Integer类型，必选，是否开启Cps，取值：0（禁用cps）、1（默认，启用cps）。
MaxconnEnable，Integer类型，必选，是否开启Maxconnection，取值：0（禁用maxconn）、1（默认，启用maxconn）。

Slimit的具体结构描述如下：

Cps，Integer类型，必选，DDoS防护策略/源新建连接限速，取值范围：100~100,000。
Maxconn，Integer类型，必选，DDoS防护策略/源并发连接限速，取值范围：1,000~1,000,000。
CpsEnable，Integer类型，必选，是否开启Cps，取值：0（禁用cps）、1（默认，启用cps）。
MaxconnEnable，Integer类型，必选，是否开启Maxconnection，取值：0（禁用maxconn）、1（默认，启用maxconn）。
CpsMode，Integer类型，必选，源新建连接限速开关，取值：1（关闭）、2（自动）。

PayloadLen的具体结构描述如下：

Min，Integer类型，必选，DDoS防护策略/包长度过滤，包长度的最小值，取值范围为0~6,000。
Max，Integer类型，必选，DDoS防护策略/包长度过滤，包长度的最大值，取值范围为0~6,000
parameters.name: config
